name: zip
description:
Reads and writes ZIP archives, including ZIP64. An archive is opened either from a List OF Byte or from an open fs::File, through the same `open` call, and both forms produce the same entries with the same contents. Opening a file-backed archive reads only the central directory, and reading one entry holds only that entry, so an archive larger than memory is readable one entry at a time.

Writing has two shapes: a Builder that holds the archive in memory until `finish`, and a Writer that writes each entry to a file as it is added, so an archive larger than memory can be written. Both produce the same bytes for the same calls.

Stored (method 0) and deflated (method 8) entries are supported; every entry read is checked against the CRC-32 recorded for it, and an entry whose bytes do not match is refused rather than returned. Encrypted archives, multi-disk archives and any other compression method are refused with errorCode::ErrUnsupported rather than guessed at. Entry names are decoded as UTF-8 when the archive says so and as CP437 otherwise, which is what the format specifies.

extractTo checks every entry before it writes anything, never overwrites a file, opens each file with containment enforced, and removes what it created if it fails.
